summary: Busy main-road kerb with a few parked cars, shops and a side car park.
reasons: Main road, only sparse kerb parking
Steep slope, driveways break the kerb

best_section.where: South kerb of Morrow Street, by the Hungry Jack's corner after the car park entrance

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto a commercial car park, a pub-style old building and trees; the nearest mapped home is by the start, over 90 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: A few cars sit on this kerb at about 100 m and 50 m, so a lane edge exists, but driveways interrupt it.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road next to a signalised junction and a rail line; constant traffic noise.
drivers.convention: Parking is heavy on the opposite side but only occasional on this kerb; no marked parking lane.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% at the best section, 7.9% over the whole stretch
Noise: arterial junction and rail line
House 9 m from the start of the line, outside the best section
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree cover on the north-west side shades the morning and afternoon edges.
cannot_judge: Use of the old building behind
